0.why: Samp.h:367-370 takes the channel count of this input for the output, and :482-484 rounds each channel to a MIDI note at note-on

1.why: Samp.h:533 reads this input with getPolyVoltage and multiplies it by 12.7 into a whole MIDI velocity of 1 to 127

2.why: Samp.h:502 reads this input with getVoltageSimd into a trigger whose thresholds are 1V and 2V (SqSchmidtTrigger.h:51-52)

3.why: Samp.h:446-448 reads this input with getPolyVoltageSimd and adds it to the pitch through the pitch trim

4.why: Samp.h:553 reads this input with getPolyVoltageSimd as the linear FM modulator

5.why: Samp.h:552 reads this input with getPolyVoltageSimd and scales it by a tenth; unpatched it is normalled to 10V

0.why: Samp.h:370 sets the channel count of this output from the pitch input

comment: Params 0, 5 and 6, the key switch, the patch schema number and the trigger delay setting, have no control on the panel. The 5 sample trigger delay is GateDelay<5> in composites/Samp.h, and TRIGGERDELAY_PARAM defaults to 1.
